comps_suites: 53 before and after: CP1's, C5, C5b, C6 and C6b answer as they did (every new switch is off by default)
words: Tests: the Hub suite went from 1,909 tests (1,900 passing) to 1,951 (1,942 passing). The same seven fail before and after and have nothing to do with this work: the Indicator Lab checkpoint, MONTH, REGIME, the age function, readiness, saved review charts and xfeed-publish. 42 tests are new and all pass: the feed (16, including the cause reproduced from the rows the deployed program read, and the program itself run end to end), growth from forecast years (8), the fiscal-year join (5, one of them running the Hub page's own picker on today's rows), the foreign peers' path (6), today's market value (4) and this page (3). The comps system's own 53 tests pass unchanged, because every new switch is off by default. Pictures: taken in a hidden browser at 1680 and 390 wide and looked at one by one; no sideways scroll, no text under 11px, BACK and CLOSE in place, no request other than a read.
